findings.title: Single-row Size/Colour edits leave the twin attribute stale on wizard-created single-variant products
findings.fix: Single-row Size: when the variant's Size changes, also mergeAttr the product's Size key if one exists. Single-row Colour: when the product's Color changes, also mergeAttr the variant's Color key if one exists. Export single-row size = variant Size else product Size; colour = product Color else variant Color. Add specs, including a no-write round trip.

findings.title: Editor/wizard can create a variant SKU equal to another product's saved Parent SKU
findings.where: VariantService.upsert; §6b parentSkuClash covers only the sheet path
findings.fix: In VariantService.upsert, 409 when product.findUnique({ where: { sku } }) is a different product. Add a spec.

findings.title: Saving sku = P via step 2/3 can take another legacy product's derived Parent SKU
findings.fix: Before saving sku P for a null-sku target T, group error when productOfDerivedSku.get(P) is a product other than T.

findings.title: Instructions don't say deleting a Child row keeps the variant
findings.fix: Add: deleting a row does not delete the product or variant; use Remove in the product editor.

findings.title: Gram values under a 'Weight (g)' header are saved x1000 with only a warning
findings.fix: Track which weight alias matched. When it was Weight (g) and the value is over 50 kg, make it a row error asking for kg.

findings.title: 429 from the global ThrottlerGuard (100/min) is not handled
findings.fix: On 429, wait Retry-After (default 60 s), show progress text, retry once, then fall back to the current error path.

findings.title: A timed-out chunk may already be saved, but the message implies it wasn't
findings.fix: For network/5xx/504 errors, append: 'Some of these rows may have been saved — uploading the same file again is safe.'

findings.title: GST list is the pre-GST-2.0 slab set (40% can't be entered)
findings.fix: Keep the owner's list in the single GST_RATES constant. Add open point A-28 for the owner. No behaviour change.

findings.title: Gallery replacement drops existing alt texts
findings.fix: alt = the existing image's alt when the same URL is kept, else ''.

findings.title: A blank indicator with parentSku === sku is inferred as a Child
findings.fix: Infer parent when parentSku is blank or equals sku. Add a spec.

findings.title: P2002 race on slug gets the raw Prisma message
findings.fix: Branch on err.meta.target: sku gets the existing message, slug gets a 'same title saved at the same moment — upload again' message.

findings.title: Editor tier tool is % off Selling Price; sheet tiers are % off MRP
findings.fix: Add a note to Instructions #10 explaining the different bases.

findings.title: AC-15 '<1 kB' vs §11 'unchanged versus master'
findings.fix: Make §11 say 'changes by less than 1 kB'.
